# An import that fetches over the network -- git:, http: -- contacts a host
# the repository chose, so it is never done unasked. A grant names the host:
# exactly, or `*.` for its subdomains and not itself. A package already in the
# cache touches no network and needs nothing.
env XDG_CACHE_HOME=$WORK/cache

! sngl check git/app.sngl
stderr 'git/app.sngl:2:1: import "git://example.invalid/p@v1#-": fetching from example.invalid needs --allow-net="example.invalid" \(or `sngl trust --allow-net="example.invalid"` to record it for this project, or with --everywhere for every project\)$'
! exists cache/sngl/git

! sngl check http/app.sngl
stderr 'import "https://example.invalid/p.tar.gz#-": fetching from example.invalid needs --allow-net="example.invalid"'

# A subdomain grant is not one for the domain itself.
! sngl check --allow-net='*.example.invalid' git/app.sngl
stderr 'fetching from example.invalid needs'

# Granted, the fetch is attempted -- and fails, there being no such host.
! sngl check --allow-net='*.invalid' git/app.sngl
stderr 'git clone'
! sngl check --allow-net=example.invalid http/app.sngl
stderr 'http get "https://example.invalid/p.tar.gz"'

# In the cache, the package is used with no network and no grant.
mkdir cache/sngl/git/example.invalid/p/v1
cp lib.sngl cache/sngl/git/example.invalid/p/v1/lib.sngl
sngl check git/app.sngl

# Recorded for a project, the grant is that project's; recorded everywhere,
# it is every project's. Nothing is recorded by import path.
rm cache/sngl/git
cd git
sngl trust --allow-net=example.invalid
stdout '^trust.allow\(origin="dir:'$WORK'/git"\) \{ trust.net\(host="example.invalid"\) \}$'
cd $WORK
! sngl check git/app.sngl
stderr 'git clone'
! sngl check http/app.sngl
stderr 'fetching from example.invalid needs'
sngl trust --everywhere --allow-net=example.invalid
stdout '^trust.everywhere \{ trust.net\(host="example.invalid"\) \}$'
! sngl check http/app.sngl
stderr 'http get'

# --everywhere grants only network access: anything else names its code.
! sngl trust --everywhere --allow-env=./pc=HOME
stderr '--everywhere records only --allow-net'

# SNGL_ALLOW carries a host, everywhere or for one origin.
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/other
env SNGL_ALLOW='net=dir:'$WORK'/http=example.invalid'
! sngl check http/app.sngl
stderr 'http get'
! sngl check git/app.sngl
stderr 'fetching from example.invalid needs'
env SNGL_ALLOW='net=example.invalid'
! sngl check git/app.sngl
stderr 'git clone'

-- git/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import p "git://example.invalid/p@v1#-"

ui.window(title=p.title)
-- http/app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import p "https://example.invalid/p.tar.gz#-"

ui.window(title=p.title)
-- lib.sngl --
// The title.
const title = "from the cache"
